title: Classic Fried Chicken Cutlets Recipe
description: Sometimes, nothing is better than traditional, right? When you know how to fry a good piece of thin cut chicken cutlet, the possibilities are endless for you to turn that ordinary chicken into a hundred masterpieces. Some tips you should keep in mind are to watch your oil… you really want to have it set at a medium high temp and wait for it to get to the desired temp before adding your chicken. If you add your chicken before the oil is sizzling, you are going to have a soggy coating on your chicken, if you cook it too high, it will be over done on the outside and raw in the middle. With caution, you can test your oil to see if it is ready by lightly flicking you dap fingers over the pan, if it sizzles and crackle it is ready, if it violently pops…. Then you have it too high and you need to turn down the temp and wait five minutes for it to adjust. Another tip, if you are creating a large batch, you may want to add or switch out your oil half way if it starts getting black and burnt looking, this can start to affect the taste.
